name: Lashed Siege Golem

Traits.name: Force Absorption
Traits.text: Whenever the siege golem is subjected to Force damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Force damage dealt.

Traits.name: Magic Resistance
Traits.text: The siege golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The siege golem makes two Timber Shoulder attacks.

Actions.name: Timber Shoulder
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 27 (5d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Breaching Shove (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* 27 (6d8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition.
Actions.expresses: shouldering through walls to open a breach

lore: Warlords build these from catapult frames and scaffold logs bound with green rope and animating iron pins, then point them at a wall and forget the crews still trapped in the firing line.

generation.userConcept: a siege-engine golem of lashed timber that shoulders through walls

clauses.text: a siege-engine golem of lashed timber

generation.cite: composition after Flesh Golem (CR 5) — the made thing that cannot be unmade

immunities: Force, Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsterDescription: a siege-engine golem of lashed timber that shoulders through walls
